description: A chorus built from two comb filters, one per side, with its own slow wobble or an outside one

params.text: Sets the delay the chorus works around, 0.1ms to 20ms
Sets how far the delay is wobbled, 1 to 3 milliseconds; with a cable in a Mod jack it becomes the attenuator for that cable
Sets how much of the delayed sound is mixed forward into the comb output, 0.01 to 1
Sets how much of the delayed sound is fed back into the comb, 0 to 1
Sets how fast the delay is wobbled, from about 0.004Hz to 16Hz as a power of two
Sets how much of the chorus is heard against the untouched signal, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Wobbles the left delay in place of the module's own slow wobble, and the Rate knob then changes nothing on that side
Wobbles the right delay in place of the module's own slow wobble, and the Rate knob then changes nothing on that side
The left signal to be chorused
The right signal to be chorused

outputs.text: The left signal mixed with its comb
The right signal mixed with its comb, or with the left signal's second comb while InR is empty

notes: nothing is computed and neither output is written until a cable is patched into InL
with InR empty and OutR patched, the left signal is put through both combs to make a stereo pair; with OutR empty as well, the two combs are averaged into OutL

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the module's own wobble.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the module's own wobble.
inputs.3:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the InL jack.
